[Happening now in ASIA ING]
We’re excited to kick off ASIA ING with our debut show “Chao 100” straight from the Chao Shan Art Museum in China! Featuring 100+ visionary designers and artists, this exhibition showcases the fusion of tradition and innovation in Chaozhou culture.

☀️28 Sep to 31 Nov 
☀️GMBB, Level 2 
☀️Daily from 11am to 8pm 

Curated by @susu_1983 @yao_1983asia 
Setup by @bookoflai @wolfidea.press

It’s finally here! We will be inviting a guest from the showcase all the way from shen zhen to conduct a portfolio review.
- 2pm to 3pm
- ASIA ING GMBB

Our humble beginning as a gallery starts with showcasing contemporary shows from Shenzhen, China. ASIA ING is dedicated to presenting what's happen”ing” in Asia, bringing the most forward-thinking exhibitions from overseas to Malaysia.

We proudly launch our journey on the second floor of GMBB, kicking off with our first show—Chao 100+1. This exhibition features 100 artists from China alongside select Malaysian talents, curated by Zhang Yi and Zeng Zhen, supported by the Chaozhou Museum of Art. This Malaysia edition is curated by @yao_1983asia , @susu_1983 , and @bookoflai 

Each artist offers their unique interpretation of the word ‘潮,’ representing Cantonese culture, pop culture, or contemporary expressions. Join us for a special portfolio review session with a guest from the exhibition on 28th September, 2 PM, free for all.
